messages:
Jordan M: deploy-bot kicked off a canary for polaris-9b-quant in us-west-2 (canary-id: c-407000). 30m safety window. dropping weight to 5% initially. tagging for visibility @Neha K @Luke P

deploy-bot: CANARY_STARTED c-407000 model=polaris-9b-quant region=us-west-2 weight=5% window=30m

Neha K: ack. quick checklist: latency vs baseline, 5xxs, mem spikes, and inference mismatch rate on eval prompts. if any of latency>1200ms P50 or error rate>0.5% we rollback. also we need fallback ordering validated in catalog-priority map.

Luke P: noted. what's current fallback ladder? last I saw it had polaris-fp16 -> atlas-8b -> base-quant. want to ensure polaris-9b-quant falls into same rung and has ttl=10m for cache evictions.

Sasha: catalog-priority.json on staging still missing polaris-9b-quant entry. I'll open a quick PR to inject:

```json
"polaris-9b-quant": {
  "priority": 10,
  "variants": ["polaris-9b-fp16", "atlas-8b"],
  "fallback_ttl_sec": 600
}
```

Jordan M: perfect. add the PR link here and set reviewers to eng-runtime + eng-releases. deploy-bot, can you wire the fallback order from catalog-priority on the canary? we should not rely on hardcoded order in runtime.

deploy-bot: CANARY_PATCHED c-407000 catalog_source=staging/catalog-priority.json fallback_resolved=true

Neha K: quick heads-up — telemetry shows a slight bump in 95th latency at 10m mark (+8%). still within threshold but trending. watching for tail. no errors.

Luke P: thanks. also double-check tokenization differences; we saw a small eval mismatch on an edge prompt yesterday with polaris tokenization. if mismatch repeats we might need rerun of compare-evals.

Sasha: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/catalog/+/2345 add polaris-9b-quant priority and TTL. tagging @eng-runtime for merge.

Jordan M: merging the PR now after 2 approvals. will bump canary weight to 25% in 10m if no regressions. rollback rules: manual rollback if any 5xx > 0.5% in 5m window OR latency P95 > 1800ms sustained for 3 consecutive 1m buckets. auto-fallback allowed to next variant if instance-level OOMs occur.

deploy-bot: CANARY_WEIGHT_UPDATE c-407000 weight=25% at=4070001530

Neha K: observability green on errors and mem. P95 still +6% vs baseline but stable. recommend continue to 50% after full 30m.

Luke P: running a fast tokenization diff now on a curated prompt set (10k queries). will post results in 15m.

Sasha: merged and promoted to prod-catalog at 4070001600. fallback map updated.

Jordan M: decision: proceed to 50% at 30m mark unless Luke calls issues. release note snippet to include: "Enable polaris-9b-quant canary in us-west-2 with fallback ladder polaris-9b-fp16 -> atlas-8b; TTL 10m; safety window 30m; rollback thresholds specified."

Luke P: token diff ok, 0.14% mismatch concentrated on rare punctuation patterns. I don't think it's a blocker but logging to evals for tracking.

Neha K: final check at 30m: errors=0.02%, P95 latency delta=+5%, memory stable. green to continue.

deploy-bot: CANARY_COMPLETED c-407000 status=promote-to-50% promoted_at=4070001829

Jordan M: thanks team. follow-up actions: (1) add token-diff alert to eval regressions dashboard (Luke), (2) monitor fallback invocations for first 24h and report anomalies (Sasha), (3) update release notes and changelog (Neha). I'll schedule a 15m retro if any rollback occurs. :thumbsup:
